result.summary: Found 1 major issue: an untranslated/unlocalized string key visible in the popular section title, indicating a missing localization mapping.

issues.description: The section header displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated string like 'Popular near you'.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation entry for this key in the localization file so the proper display text renders instead of the raw key.
